{{Top|leg}}
'''038145''' was an accident report concerning a fire in the central shaft of Level 12, Sector B, in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The fire started in one of the processors; security [[S-03-38|reported]] that several workers testified that the processor in question had been recently serviced and was in working order. The fire was extinguished by seven [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] that had been retasked from other levels to combat the blaze. Two workers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by smoke inhalation, and six were [[M-03-21|admitted]] to the [[Medcenter/Legends|infirmary]]. Financial costs for damages incurred in the accident were [[D-03-57|reported]] as 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standards]]. New equipment was [[Q-03-1648|requisitioned]] to replace what was lost.
